verdict.rationale: Orama JS documents a first-party bulk insert, `insertMultiple`, recommended for large record sets and offering a configurable batch size (default 1000). The pack only evidences bulk insertion, so bulk update, delete or other mass operations across many items are unproven. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete (e.g. multi-remove or multi-update), bulk operations in the Cloud/MCP surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: If you have a lot of records, we suggest using the insertMultiple function... You can pass a third, optional, parameter to change the batch size (default: 1000).
Inserting a large number of documents in a loop could potentially block the event loop. Instead `insertMultiple` handles this case better.
